title: Administrator Portion on Early Payoff Terminations
content:
# Administrator Portion on Early Payoff Terminations

Administrator agreement table, Kessler GAP Waiver Addenda (deal types as recorded in the group's Vehicle Purchase Agreements). When a Kessler GAP waiver is terminated after the lienholder reports the loan paid off or refinanced away, the program administrator keeps a portion of the waiver's price according to the deal type recorded on the Vehicle Purchase Agreement that carries the waiver.

| Deal type of the waiver's own Vehicle Purchase Agreement | Portion withheld from the price |
|---|---|
| New Vehicle Retail Purchase or New Vehicle Factory Order Purchase | 30.00 |
| Used Vehicle Retail Purchase, Certified Pre-Owned Vehicle Purchase or Value Line Used Vehicle Purchase | 45.00 |
| Any other deal type, such as a Fleet Vehicle Purchase Agreement | Nothing |

The portion is withheld from the waiver's price before the unused termination share is applied; the share then multiplies the price less the portion.

**Illustration (hypothetical figures).** A waiver priced 681.00 with 1,200 of 1,826 calendar days unused:

- on a New Vehicle Factory Order Purchase: 651.00 times 1,200 divided by 1,826 is 427.8204..., rounded to 427.82;
- on a Value Line Used Vehicle Purchase: 636.00 times the same share is 417.9628..., rounded to 417.96;
- on a Fleet Vehicle Purchase Agreement: the share applies to the full 681.00.

**Which deal is read.** The purchase deal on which the waiver was sold; a later purchase by the same holder does not change the portion.
